<!-- Generated by scripts/build_api_reference.py from /api/v1/openapi.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

The machine-readable contract is [`/api/v1/openapi.json`](https://mapsurvey.org/api/v1/openapi.json)
(OpenAPI 3.1): load it into Postman, Insomnia or a client generator. This page is generated from it.
To make your first call, see [Use the REST API](/how-to/use-the-rest-api/).

**Base URL** `https://mapsurvey.org/api/v1` · **Authentication** `Authorization: Bearer <token>` —
a [personal token](/how-to/personal-tokens/) or an OAuth 2.1 access token · **Plan** the workspace
that owns the survey must be on [Pro](/reference/plans-and-billing/).

## Errors

Every error has the same shape: `{"error": "<code>", "detail": "<text>", ...}`. Switch on `error`;
`detail` is for people and may change. `validation` errors add `fields` (field name → messages),
and an unknown field in a request body is refused by name rather than ignored.

| Code | Status | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `invalid_token` | 401 | No bearer token, or one that is unknown, expired or revoked. |
| `scope_missing` | 403 | The token lacks the permission this call needs (`scope` names it). |
| `pro_required` | 403 | The survey's workspace is not on Pro (`upgrade_url` links to its billing page). |
| `forbidden_role` | 403 | You can see the survey but your role on it is too low (`role` names the one needed). |
| `not_found` | 404 | Nothing there — or nothing you may see. The two are deliberately the same answer. |
| `validation` | 422 | The body or a parameter is invalid; `fields` lists what and why. |
| `draft_required` | 409 | A structural change to a live survey: start unpublished changes (`draft` is their uuid when they exist). |
| `answers_at_risk` | 409 | The delete would remove `count` answers; repeat with `acknowledge_answer_loss=true`. |
| `delete_blocked` | 409 | Something else depends on what you are deleting. |
| `translation_gaps` | 409 | Some languages are missing text; repeat with `acknowledge_translation_gaps: true`. |
| `incompatible_draft` | 409 | Unpublished changes conflict with collected answers; repeat with `force: true`. |
| `transition_refused` | 409 | The survey cannot move to that status from where it is. |
| `conflict` | 409 | The request conflicts with the current state (e.g. unpublished changes already exist). |
| `bad_cursor` | 400 | The pagination cursor is not valid for this list. |
| `method_not_allowed` | 405 | That HTTP method is not offered on this path (`Allow` lists the ones that are). |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | Too many calls; wait `Retry-After` seconds. |
| `server_error` | 500 | Our fault. It is logged; retrying later is safe for reads. |


## Account

### `GET /me`

The token's user, its workspaces with their plan and whether the API is
included, and the token's kind, scopes, audiences, binding and expiry.

**200** MeOut

Errors: `forbidden_role`, `invalid_token`, `method_not_allowed`, `not_found`, `pro_required`, `rate_limited`, `scope_missing`, `server_error`, `validation`

## Import

### `POST /surveys/import`

Import a survey ZIP (the editor's "Backup (survey file)") as a job.
Poll `/import-jobs/{id}` until `status` is `done` or `failed`.

**Body**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | binary | yes |  |
| `workspace` | string or null |  |  |

**202** ImportJobOut

Errors: `forbidden_role`, `invalid_token`, `method_not_allowed`, `not_found`, `pro_required`, `rate_limited`, `scope_missing`, `server_error`, `validation`

**200** ExportLinkOut

Errors: `forbidden_role`, `invalid_token`, `method_not_allowed`, `not_found`, `pro_required`, `rate_limited`, `scope_missing`, `server_error`, `validation`

### `PATCH /surveys/{uuid}/responses/{response_id}`

Approve, hold or reject a response (`""` clears the status). Rejected
responses leave exports, summaries and public results; shared-map layers
are rebuilt. Needs the editor role.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uuid` | path | uuid | yes |
| `response_id` | path | integer | yes |

**Body**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `validation_status` | `approved` | `not_approved` | `on_hold` | `` | yes |  |

**200** no body

Errors: `forbidden_role`, `invalid_token`, `method_not_allowed`, `not_found`, `pro_required`, `rate_limited`, `scope_missing`, `server_error`, `validation`

## Share

### `GET /surveys/{uuid}/share`

How to send the survey out: its link, the public results link, the embed
snippet and allowed hosts -- once it is published (`shareable`). In testing,
editors also get the test link with its token.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uuid` | path | uuid | yes |

**200** no body

Errors: `forbidden_role`, `invalid_token`, `method_not_allowed`, `not_found`, `pro_required`, `rate_limited`, `scope_missing`, `server_error`, `validation`

### `GET /surveys/{uuid}/share/qr.{fmt}`

A QR code of the survey link (or of tracked link `link`) for posters and
flyers. `size` is pixels per module, 1-40.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uuid` | path | uuid | yes |
| `fmt` | path | `svg` | `png` | yes |
| `size` | query | integer |  |
| `link` | query | integer or null |  |

**200** no body

Errors: `forbidden_role`, `invalid_token`, `method_not_allowed`, `not_found`, `not_shareable`, `pro_required`, `rate_limited`, `scope_missing`, `server_error`, `validation`

### `GET /surveys/{uuid}/tracked-links`

Campaign links -- the survey link with UTM parameters -- with how many
responses started and completed through each.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uuid` | path | uuid | yes |

**200** no body

Errors: `forbidden_role`, `invalid_token`, `method_not_allowed`, `not_found`, `pro_required`, `rate_limited`, `scope_missing`, `server_error`, `validation`

### `POST /surveys/{uuid}/tracked-links`

Add a campaign link (editor role). At most 200 per survey.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uuid` | path | uuid | yes |

**Body**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `utm_source` | string | yes | Where the link is posted, e.g. "newsletter". |
| `utm_medium` | string |  | e.g. "email", "poster", "social". |
| `utm_campaign` | string |  | e.g. "spring-2027". |

**200** no body

Errors: `forbidden_role`, `invalid_token`, `limit_reached`, `method_not_allowed`, `not_found`, `pro_required`, `rate_limited`, `scope_missing`, `server_error`, `validation`

### `DELETE /surveys/{uuid}/tracked-links/{link_id}`

Remove a campaign link (editor role). Responses that came through it keep their source.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uuid` | path | uuid | yes |
| `link_id` | path | integer | yes |

**200** no body

Errors: `forbidden_role`, `invalid_token`, `method_not_allowed`, `not_found`, `pro_required`, `rate_limited`, `scope_missing`, `server_error`, `validation`

### `PUT /surveys/{uuid}/share/embed-hosts`

Which sites may embed the survey (editor role); an empty list lets any site.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uuid` | path | uuid | yes |

**Body**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hosts` | list of string | yes | Sites allowed to embed the survey, e.g. ["example.org", "*.city.gov"]; empty = any site. |

**200** no body

Errors: `forbidden_role`, `invalid_token`, `method_not_allowed`, `not_found`, `pro_required`, `rate_limited`, `scope_missing`, `server_error`, `validation`
